mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate profit growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5% over the last 3 years, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede a decline in equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise > 0.1pp in 1 month) over the last 3 years, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and tightening in monetary policy (FEDFUNDS) signal a shift toward a restrictive monetary environment, which typically leads to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL m/m > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS m/m > 0.25%) over the last 3 years, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (characterized by strong industrial production and low unemployment), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an over-tightening of monetary policy, which typically triggers a sell-off in equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.25% in 1 month) during late-cycle expansion periods over the last 3 years, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.3% signals weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (RSAFS m/m < -0.3%) over the last 3 years, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 indicates expanding manufacturing activity and stronger corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 100 over the last 3 years, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer spending and business investment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 690000) over the last 3 years, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.4% month-over-month for two consecutive months signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed delays rate cuts.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL m/m > 0.4% for 2 consecutive months) over the last 3 years, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.05.
